title: Write ratings, labels and reject flags into original JPEG metadata
source: rapidroom (original JPEG metadata writer and native validation)
highlight: Optionally save culling decisions inside JPEGs without re-encoding pixels, with batch reports and Undo.
notes: Off by default. Writes XMP ratings and explicit colour-label changes, preserves existing external labels on rating-only writes, and updates existing EXIF rating fields using atomic metadata-only replacement; preserves scans, foreign metadata and file properties. Library manual write works independently of automatic embedding. Extended XMP is refused. MPF/APP11 auxiliary previews, trailing data or fixed EXIF positions can require existing XMP padding; otherwise the original is left unchanged and the report directs the user to sidecar metadata. Other formats retain existing sidecar behavior. Windows/macOS are untested; locked replacement may be refused on Windows.
